plan.scope: existing exported excursion labels only; no raw-price execution, no P&L, no blind holdout, no gates cleared
plan.question: Incremental descriptive value of fast exit within wide prior-range context, versus range-only and speed-only
plan.weights: Reuse prior within-block weights; aggregate buckets by their weight mass, never average bucket rates unweighted. Equal mean of three block rates.
plan.independent_check: Recompute every policy rate directly from exact pinned raw exports, independent Counter weights and math.fsum; use published training-only edges unchanged
plan.limitations: History already exposed; source/geometry as-of uncertified; excursion is bounded from exited edge, not entry returns. Fast exit timing is anchor-to-exit, not distance-per-bar or pullback speed.

profile_resolution: Profiler date hint is refuted: bucket values like 0:2 are categorical tercile identifiers, not dates. Profiler daily sum hints are invalid because metric rows repeat denominators and groups overlap; never sum rows/sessions across thresholds. policy and bucket rows overlap across distances by design, not independent events; rows is event-cell count; source CSV unique at declared metric grain; raw same six previously profiled exports, no source change

comparison_plan.question: Does fast exit add reach beyond wide range alone?
comparison_plan.grain: policy x fixed-tick threshold, equal mean of3 prior blocks
comparison_plan.population: eligible resolved exits, nested policies, real cohort
comparison_plan.derivation: weight-mass recombination of prior buckets, verified from raw
comparison_plan.finding: computed in policy summary; no winning-policy promotion
comparison_plan.reason: Four overlapping policies compared without stacking; preserve all four thresholds

comparison_plan.question: What is coverage and temporal reversal?
comparison_plan.reason: Coverage is not fills; keep any negative within-block incremental effect
comparison_plan.finding: Speed within wide positive every block and all declared thresholds; effect varies strongly; coverage shrinks

comparison_plan.question: Do controls replicate and do wide speed terciles differ?
comparison_plan.grain: cohort and speed bucket within wide
comparison_plan.reason: Retain counterevidence to zone-specific mechanism; no additional fitted recipes

comparison_plan.question: Does falling all-case distance coverage imply late entries are worse?
comparison_plan.grain: prior block x reached excursion level
comparison_plan.population: retrospective paths reaching each level, not trades
comparison_plan.unit: conditional path-reach percent versus all-case joint reach
comparison_plan.finding: Compute changing denominator explicitly; no entry-time or fill comparison exists
comparison_plan.reason: Four offsets are a compact lookup; do not imply a trading win-rate

conditional_interpretation: Retrospective nested maximum events, NOT actual filled trades or probability of success after an executable entry. Falling all-case reach as threshold increases is tautological, not evidence that late filled trades have worse expectancy. These ratios have different denominator than prior all-case scenarios.

additional_checks.capture_definition: each block: policy weighted mass reaching threshold / ALL weighted mass reaching threshold; then equal mean of3 ratios
additional_checks.conditional_definition: each block: nested reach(offset+target)/reach(offset), then equal mean of3 ratios; not ratio of mean rates
additional_checks.source_csv_hint_resolution: bucket=0:2 etc are categorical, not dates; repeated rows/sessions are denominators, not additive daily volume
